title: Rollout Asset Studies
description: Five independent studies of adjacent release assets that support an album-cover system, from still-life inserts to promo card surfaces.
creative_direction: Independent studies expand the release world into gatefold still life, square promo tile, collector flat lay, wall poster, and sticker-sheet style surfaces. Each image should feel commercially plausible for music marketing without becoming a literal mockup with readable brand text.
